text:
Aim assist and radar hacks for a live ranked multiplayer game aren't something I'll write. These tools harm real people competing in good faith, and that holds regardless of how the request is framed.

If you're working on something legitimate — a game client, a spectator tool, a local single-player mod — I'm glad to help with that instead.
